block-content-type.description: Content-Type declared for the WARC record block.

block-length.description: WARC Content-Length of the record block in bytes, independent of the HTTP Content-Length.

declared-block-digest.description: Digest value declared by WARC-Block-Digest for the record block.

declared-payload-digest.description: Digest value declared by WARC-Payload-Digest for the payload.

http-response-header.description: One archived HTTP response header represented as JSON with a lowercase name and its value.

http-status.description: Status code in the archived HTTP response.

http-version.description: HTTP version in the archived response status line.

member-path.description: Relative ZIP path of the WARC member in the source WACZ.

record-id.description: WARC-Record-ID URI without its enclosing angle brackets.

record-offset.description: Zero-based byte offset of the record in the uncompressed WARC member or standalone WARC stream.

record-type.description: WARC record type of the archived capture.

refers-to.description: Original WARC-Refers-To identifying a related record, such as a record revisited by this capture.

refers-to-date.description: WARC-Refers-To-Date of the earlier capture, normalized to UTC when the source includes seconds.

refers-to-date-raw.description: Original WARC-Refers-To-Date of the earlier capture, with the source timestamp precision.

target-uri.description: Original HTTP or HTTPS target URI in WARC-Target-URI.

warc-date-raw.description: Original WARC-Date value, including source timestamp precision.

warc-profile.description: WARC-Profile URI declaring how a revisit's record block and payload are to be interpreted. Required for revisit records.

warc-version.description: Version of the WARC record format.

description: Metadata for a captured HTTP or HTTPS resource in a WARC record. Link the record to its source WARC or WACZ file and the corresponding page capture.
name: warc-record
